{{Quote|Lost Ahrens.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]] announces Ahrens' death to the rest of the 77th Air Wing|<ref name="The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai">{{InsiderCite|132|The Guns of Kelrodo-Ai (short story)}}</ref>}}
'''Ahrens''', also known by the callsign '''Blade Three''', was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who was a member of [[Blade Flight]], a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit that flew [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] and formed part of the [[77th Air Wing]]. In [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the 77th Air Wing was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kelrodo-Ai/Legends|Kelrodo-Ai]] to [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai|drive]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Separatist holdouts|holdout forces]] from the world, as part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]]. During an assault on the [[Citadel of Axes]], a Confederate-held [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], Ahrens' fighter was hit by a blast from a Separatist anti-[[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] cannon, which [[Death/Legends|killed]] the pilot.
